Happy Birthday
13 October
Laiba Jabbar
To my bestest friend, a little late on your day, but written with all my heart.
SCROLL
A SINCERE SORRY

I'm sorry this wish is late.

I really wanted to be the first to wish you, right at 12. Here is the honest story of why I wasn't.

LAST NIGHT, BEFORE 12
I made this for you
I put my own paper preparation aside to build your birthday wish, because my bestest friend matters more than a few extra hours of study.
THE MISSING PIECE
I didn't have your pictures
I didn't want to send you something generic. A wish for you should have you in it, so I tried to find your photos, and I couldn't.
TODAY
Your pictures arrived
I finally got them from you today, and I also had my anatomy exam on the same day. The moment both were done, I came straight back to finish this.
NOW
Better late than not at all
Still on your day, still from the heart. Please forgive me for the delay.
Laiba
The birthday girl

A DUA FOR YOUR JOURNEY

رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا

"My Lord, increase me in knowledge."

Surah Taha (20:114)

رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي

"My Lord, expand my chest and ease my task for me."

Surah Taha (20:25-26)

فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا

"Indeed, with hardship comes ease."

Surah Ash-Sharh (94:5)

GRATITUDE & BLESSINGS

لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ

"If you are grateful, I will surely increase you."

Surah Ibrahim (14:7)

رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً

"Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter."

Surah Al-Baqarah (2:201)
